name: The Eye of Timaeus
desc:
(This card is also always treated as "Legendary Dragon Timaeus".)
Target 1 "Dark Magician" monster you control; Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck that mentions that monster on the field as material, using it as the Fusion Material.

name: The Fang of Critias
desc:
(This card is also always treated as "Legendary Dragon Critias".)
Send 1 Trap from your hand or field to the GY, that is listed on a Fusion Monster that can only be Special Summoned with "The Fang of Critias" (if that card is Set, reveal it); Special Summon that Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck.

name: The Claw of Hermos
desc:
(This card is also always treated as "Legendary Dragon Hermos".)
Send 1 monster from your hand or field to the GY, of the Type that is listed on a Fusion Monster that can only be Special Summoned with "The Claw of Hermos"; Special Summon that Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck.

name: Legend of Heart
desc: Pay 1000 LP, then Tribute 1 Warrior monster; banish up to 3 "Legendary Dragon" Spells with different names from your hand and/or GY, and if you do, Special Summon that many "Legendary Knight" monsters with different names from your hand and/or GY. When this card resolves, you can banish 1 face-up Spell/Trap on the field.

name: Legendary Knight Timaeus
desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned with "Legend of Heart". When this card is Special Summoned: You can target 1 face-up Spell/Trap on the field; banish that target. When this card is targeted for an attack: You can target 1 Spell in your GY; Set that target.

name: Legendary Knight Critias
desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned with "Legend of Heart". When this card is Special Summoned: You can target 1 face-up Spell/Trap on the field; banish that target. When this card is targeted for an attack: You can target 1 Trap in your GY; Set that target.

name: Legendary Knight Hermos
desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned with "Legend of Heart". When this card is Special Summoned: You can target 1 face-up Spell/Trap on the field; banish that target. When this card is targeted for an attack: You can target 1 Effect Monster in your GY; this card gains that monster's effects until the End Phase.

name: Dark Magician Girl the Dragon Knight
desc:
"Dark Magician Girl" + 1 Dragon monster (o "The Eye of Timaeus")
Once per turn: You can send 1 card from your hand to the GY, then target 1 face-up card on the field; destroy that target.

name: Amulet Dragon
desc:
"Dark Magician" + 1 Dragon monster (o "The Eye of Timaeus")
If Special Summoned: Target any number of Spell Cards in any GY (min. 1); banish those targets, and if you do, this card gains 100 ATK for each card banished. If this card is destroyed: You can target 1 Spellcaster monster in your GY; Special Summon that target.

name: Mirror Force Dragon
desc:
Must be Special Summoned with "The Fang of Critias", using "Mirror Force".
When a monster(s) you control is targeted for an attack or by an opponent's card effect: You can destroy all cards your opponent controls.

name: Doom Virus Dragon
desc:
Must be Special Summoned with "The Fang of Critias", using "Crush Card Virus".
If this card is Special Summoned: Look at your opponent's hand, all monsters they control, and destroy all those monsters with 1500 or more ATK.

name: Tyrant Burst Dragon
desc:
Must be Special Summoned with "The Fang of Critias", using "Tyrant Wing".
This card can attack all opponent's monsters once each. You can target 1 face-up monster you control; equip this card to that target. It gains 400 ATK/DEF, also it can make 3 attacks during each Battle Phase.

name: Red-Eyes Black Dragon Sword
desc:
Must be Special Summoned with "The Claw of Hermos", sending a Dragon monster from your hand or field to the GY.
If this card is Special Summoned: Target 1 other face-up monster on the field; equip this card to it. It gains 1000 ATK, plus 500 ATK/DEF for each Dragon monster on the field and in the GYs.

name: Time Magic Hammer
desc:
Must be Special Summoned with "The Claw of Hermos", sending a Spellcaster monster from your hand or field to the GY.
If this card is Special Summoned: Target 1 other face-up monster on the field; equip this card to it. At the start of the Damage Step, if it battles an opponent's monster: You can roll a six-sided die, and banish that opponent's monster.

name: Goddess Bow
desc:
Must be Special Summoned with "The Claw of Hermos", sending an Aqua monster from your hand or field to the GY.
If this card is Special Summoned: Target 1 other face-up monster on the field; equip this card to it. During the Battle Phase, if an opponent's card effect is activated, negate that effect, also the equipped monster can make a second attack during this Battle Phase.

name: Rocket Hermos Cannon
desc:
Must be Special Summoned with "The Claw of Hermos", sending a Warrior monster from your hand or field to the GY.
If this card is Special Summoned: Target 1 other face-up monster on the field; equip this card to it. It can make a second attack during each Battle Phase, and if it attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage.
